page.overview:
What is Ash's Pikachu?

This Pikachu is an -type Pokémon owned by Ash. He is his very best friend and comrade.

Just like its mainstream counterpart, Pikachu had no interest in Ash when they first met, but after Ash protected him from a flock of angry Spearow, Pikachu started to listen to Ash. In this universe, Pikachu actually showed more of a on-screen bond with Ash than in the main timeline. In this timeline, Pikachu shares the same capabilities of the main timeline version of itself. In this alternate timeline, Pikachu was not taken to the Pokémon Center, and didn't blow it up.

Thunderbolt; Electric; MS020: Pokémon the Movie: I Choose You! Quick Attack; Normal; MS020: Pokémon the Movie: I Choose You! Iron Tail; Steel; MS020: Pokémon the Movie: I Choose You!
